newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Aug 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Aug 5.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
PEOPLE'S DAILY
- Front page story stresses China still is in primary stage of socialism and has a long way to go to increase production and improve the economy and standard of living.

- In the first half, year, state-owned industries in Hunan province had 4.32 billion yuan in pre-tax profits, an increase of 28.61 percent over the same period last year, and profits of 302 million yuan more.
- Government offices in Hebei province have helped 300,000 unemployed workers find jobs in the past two years.
- Survey shows among registered drug addicts, those under 35 account for 80 percent and those under 25 account for 65 percent
XINHUA DAILY TELEGRAPH
- In the past five years, China's market economy has become more rational, with retail and wholesale business and the financial, real estate, technology, information, and labour markets developing.
- The All-China's Women's Federation calls on various women's organisations and all women to contribute to the country's cultural and ethical progress.
CHINA SECURITIES
- China's economy forecast to grow by 9.4 percent in third quarter, retail price inflation seen up by 1.5 percent in third quarter
- Per capita gross domestic product in Shanghai to top $3,000 this year
- By end-June, sales of sugar reached 4.96 tonnes in China
FINANCIAL NEWS
- China's economy forecast to grow by 10 percent this year, retail price inflation seen up 3.5 percent for the year
INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS DAILY
- Trade between China and Africa rose 45 percent to $2.551 billion in first half
ECONOMIC INFORMATION DAILY
- First phase of Dahongshan copper mine put into operation with annual copper output expected at 7,023 tonnes
- First phase of alumina project in Shanxi Yuncheng Shanhe Aluminium Co put into operation with production capacity of 12,500 tonnes a year
CHINA DAILY
-- China has had two major highs and lows in grain production in past 13 years, forcing it to face market fluctuations, and now is experienced enough to balance the two, economists say.
- Qu Geping, president of the China Environment Protection Foundation, says it now has special funds to support enterprises producing environmentally friendly products.
- The Communist Party Central Committee and central government urge local officials to stop levying unauthorised fees, to relieve state-owned enterprises of their burdens.
